headword: {高校野球|こうこうやきゅう}

definitions.explanation: Baseball played at the high school level in Japan. A hugely popular spectator sport, centered around the national tournament held at Koshien Stadium.

examples.japanese: {高校野球|こうこうやきゅう}の{季節|きせつ}がやってきた。
examples.english: The high school baseball season has arrived.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}の{高校野球|こうこうやきゅう}はテレビで{生中継|なまちゅうけい}される。
examples.english: Summer high school baseball is broadcast live on TV.

examples.japanese: {高校野球|こうこうやきゅう}の{甲子園|こうしえん}{大会|たいかい}は{毎年|まいとし}{多|おお}くの{感動|かんどう}を{生|う}む{日本|にほん}の{夏|なつ}の{風物詩|ふうぶつし}だ。
examples.english: The Koshien high school baseball tournament is a summer tradition in Japan that produces many emotional moments every year.

notes:
A compound of {高校|こうこう} (high school) and {野球|やきゅう} (baseball). One of the most popular spectator sports in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高校野球|こうこうやきゅう}の{大会|たいかい}: high school baseball tournament
- {高校野球|こうこうやきゅう}の{選手|せんしゅ}: high school baseball player
- {夏|なつ}の{高校野球|こうこうやきゅう}: summer high school baseball

CULTURAL NOTE:
High school baseball holds a special place in Japanese culture. The two major national tournaments are held at {甲子園|こうしえん} ({阪神甲子園球場|はんしんこうしえんきゅうじょう}) in Hyogo Prefecture: the {選抜|せんばつ}{大会|たいかい} (Spring Invitational) and the {選手権|せんしゅけん}{大会|たいかい} (Summer Championship). The summer tournament in particular draws enormous nationwide attention, with games broadcast live on NHK. It is often simply called {甲子園|こうしえん}.

RELATED WORDS:
- {甲子園|こうしえん}: Koshien — synonymous with the high school baseball tournament
- {球児|きゅうじ}: young baseball player — often used for high school baseball players
